caption: A construction worker uses a socket wrench to turn a large bolt on a metal beam, the wrench exerting significant force.
positive_analysis:
1. Hand grips wrench handle, applying torque to bolt via socket engagement.  
2. Wrench head fits bolt threads, transferring rotational force to fastener.  
3. Bolt remains stationary until sufficient torque overcomes friction or resistance.  
4. Metal beam surface shows static contact, no visible fluid movement or deformation.
